title: Formal partial derivatives of multivariate power series
statement: For a commutative ring $R$, a finite variable index type $\sigma$, and $P=R[[x_i]]_{i\in\sigma}$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], the formal partial derivative $\partial/\partial x_i$ is the $R$-derivation $P\to P$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] whose coefficient at a multi-index $d$ is the coefficient of the original series at $d+e_i$ multiplied by $d_i+1$; equivalently it sends $x_i$ to $1$, every $x_j$ with $j\ne i$ to $0$, and satisfies the Leibniz rule.

source.place: Tag 0C4B (lemma-fitting-ideal-well-defined), formal power-series Jacobian differentiation. The precise coefficientwise definition and derivation laws are MvPowerSeries.pderiv in Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Derivative.lean:52-56,118-145 (see mathlib_match).
